metrics_scope: Notebook metrics describe the 746/187 holdout experiment before the final full-cohort refit of the serialized stack. Random Forest CV 0.705 ± 0.035 is not a stacking CV result.
known_data_limitations: Raw scraped observations mix sale and rental listings; notebook sale filtering precedes modeling.
Training Area combines listing area, terrain-derived values and manual corrections; net habitable area is not consistently established.
Training target currency correction includes a fixed 10.8 multiplier and heuristic/out-of-fold/agency-specific assumptions; these are not inference transforms.
Numerical group imputation was performed outside the fitted pipelines and before train/test split; strict complete inputs avoid that path at inference.
Condition and age text preparation and fallback constants are external to the serialized model; missing categorical inputs have no default in the initial strict release contract.
Construction-year preparation depends on datetime.now().year, and the historical reference year is not stored as release evidence.
Test metrics influenced selection of stacking components and final model; label corrections used the wider cohort, creating evaluation optimism risks.
marrakech_clean.csv export fills missing prices with medians; later Price_final may contain predictions. Neither is automatically observed market-price data.
Two combinations of accepted location/type categories are absent from fitted TargetEncoder categories; their scope is not certified by golden examples.
Notebook final save cell has execution_count=null despite output; delivered artifact identity and checksum remain authoritative.
